02 / The mountain

Meet you
at Gore.

Gore Mountain is tucked into the Adirondacks in North Creek, New York. Ski and ride across its connected mountain areas, then wind down at the historic North Creek Ski Bowl.

Check the mountain’s official site for lift tickets, rentals, trail conditions, and operating hours as the trip gets closer.
